candidate.name: MCL Two-Speed Anchored Auction Relay
candidate.daily_opportunity_law: three immutable global oil auctions, each permitting at most one matured decision

state_machine.formation: freeze each block's first 30 or 45 completed CL one-minute bars as opening high, low, volume-weighted mean, width, and path efficiency
state_machine.probe: after formation, CL trades 0.05 or 0.10 frozen opening-width beyond either boundary
state_machine.acceptance: two or three consecutive completed CL closes remain beyond the frozen boundary; the latest completed five-minute 1/3/6-bar majority agrees; current CL one-minute volume is at least 1.00 or 1.25 times the causal median of the previous 20 bars; matched-month MCL moves in the same direction
state_machine.failure: only when formation efficiency is at most 0.55; within five completed minutes after a probe, CL closes at least 0.05 opening-width back inside and MCL reverses by at least one tick from its probe extreme
state_machine.mutual_exclusion: the first matured acceptance or failure consumes that auction block even if admission later fails; no other decision can be manufactured in the block
state_machine.entry: next exact-month MCL one-minute open after maturation
state_machine.acceptance_exit: 1.00 opening-width favorable target, 0.25 opening-width close back inside the boundary, opposite completed five-minute majority, 0.75 opening-width adverse stop, or 90-minute timeout
state_machine.failure_exit: frozen opening VWAP target, probe-extreme plus 0.10 opening-width adverse stop, opposite completed five-minute majority, or 45-minute timeout
state_machine.safety: one open position maximum; a later block cannot enter until flat; no entry after 16:25 ET; force flat by 16:55 ET and at any roll or clock discontinuity

bounded_cells.ranking: on discovery only: pass 160-trade/PF/net floor, then maximize positive quarter count, worst quarter net, net/intrabar-DD, PF, and net in that order; validation cannot select or tune a cell
